[Ohio SB 472] Designate State Senator I. Ray Miller Jr. Memorial Highway — To enact section 5534.506 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of U.S. Route 62 in Columbus as the "State Senator I. Ray Miller Jr. Memorial Highway."

[Ohio HB 518] Regards truancy, contributing to delinquency of a child — To amend sections 2151.354, 2152.19, and 2919.24 of the Revised Code relative to truancy and contributing to the unruliness or delinquency of a child.

[Ohio HB 305] Enact Logan's Law — To amend sections 2925.03, 2929.14, and 3705.08 and to enact section 2941.1427 of the Revised Code to establish penalties for trafficking in pressed pill fentanyl, to require a death certificate to indicate if a death is caused by fentanyl poisoning, and to name this act Logan's Law.
